rulings.restated: Find the entry in Qualified long-term care premium limit by age (Form 7206, line 2(b)) for age helper "That person's age at the end of 2025".
rulings.model: The age bands and use of age at year-end match "Use the person's age at the end of the tax year," but the restated table's dollar amounts are not provided, so they cannot be compared with the IRS's $480, $900, $1,800, $4,810, and $6,020. The restatement also does not show how it handles the multiple-business rule that the total on line 2 of "all Form(s) 7206 can't be more than the appropriate limit shown on line 2 for that person."
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; restatement accepted. tables/2025/ltc_limit.yaml holds $480, $900, $1,800, $4,810 and $6,020, the f7206 line 2 amounts by age at year-end. The multiple-business rule is refused by sc.hi_screen ("anyone is covered by qualified long-term care insurance entered for more than one business on this return").
